intent: Sum available_today_quantity of the specific Honeywell FFP2 dust-mask respirator across every Vienna PowerTool store (including stores with zero availability) and report as 'qty %d', citing all Vienna store records plus the product record.
success_criteria: Exactly one product_sku resolves matching brand, family line, mask_type, protection_class, and size
All Vienna stores enumerated via LEFT JOIN so zero-availability branches are included
Total equals SUM(COALESCE(available_today_quantity,0)) over all Vienna stores
refs contain the product record path and every Vienna store record path

args.stdin: SELECT v.product_sku, v.record_path AS product_path FROM product_variants v JOIN product_families f ON v.product_family_id = f.product_family_id WHERE v.brand = :brand AND f.product_family_name = :line AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key='mask_type' AND p.property_value_text = :mask_type) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key='protection_class' AND p.property_value_text = :protection_class) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND p.property_key='size' AND p.property_value_text = :size);

WITH target AS (SELECT v.product_sku, v.record_path FROM product_variants v JOIN product_families f ON v.product_family_id = f.product_family_id WHERE v.brand = :brand AND f.product_family_name = :line AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=v.product_sku AND p.property_key='mask_type' AND p.property_value_text=:mask_type) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=v.product_sku AND p.property_key='protection_class' AND p.property_value_text=:protection_class) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=v.product_sku AND p.property_key='size' AND p.property_value_text=:size)) SELECT s.store_id, s.record_path AS store_path, t.product_sku, t.record_path AS product_path, COALESCE(i.available_today_quantity,0) AS available_today FROM stores s CROSS JOIN target t LEFT JOIN store_inventory i ON i.store_id=s.store_id AND i.product_sku=t.product_sku WHERE s.city = :city ORDER BY s.store_id;

WITH target AS (SELECT v.product_sku FROM product_variants v JOIN product_families f ON v.product_family_id = f.product_family_id WHERE v.brand = :brand AND f.product_family_name = :line AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=v.product_sku AND p.property_key='mask_type' AND p.property_value_text=:mask_type) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=v.product_sku AND p.property_key='protection_class' AND p.property_value_text=:protection_class) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=v.product_sku AND p.property_key='size' AND p.property_value_text=:size)) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(i.available_today_quantity,0)),0) AS total_available FROM stores s CROSS JOIN target t LEFT JOIN store_inventory i ON i.store_id=s.store_id AND i.product_sku=t.product_sku WHERE s.city = :city;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
